name: frontend-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the frontend stack category in one install — UI/UX stacks, web-dev (Next.js, React Native, Vite skills with /web-dev:review, the generalist worker and the opus-floored frontend-reviewer), accessibility auditing, and skill auto-routing (skill-router). Inertia lives in the laravel plugin (php-suite). The creative-build studio — craft-layer, design-preview, shadcn-studio, registry-source, threejs — moved to craft-suite, so ordinary frontend app work does not pay the studio's always-on context. Uninstall cleanly with /frontend-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.
